# Core tasks

24 task types · 88 frozen data variants · 10 MRI research domains.

Browse by domain and task code. Each folder contains its specification, generator, grader, reference solution and validation controls. The [task guide](../docs/TASKS.md) explains inputs, deliverables and checks; the [numbering guide](../docs/TASK-IDS.md) lists all public and legacy IDs.
